name: Barbell Reverse-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted firmly and grip the barbell wider than shoulder width using an underhand palms-facing-you grip.
Unrack carefully above your chest with thumbs wrapped securely and shoulder blades pinned into the pad.
Lower the bar slowly down to your lower chest while keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press the bar smoothly up and slightly back over your shoulders, then rerack with control.
tips: Always wrap both thumbs firmly around the bar for safety with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows close to your ribs to keep your wrists and shoulders comfortable.
